name: Bencho
summary: Library of interactive React UI blocks and micro-interactions, plus 82 UI sounds and a wall of 158 interaction clips.
description: A library of interactive React components and micro-interactions you can explore, tweak and take straight into your projects. Alongside the blocks it holds 82 browser-synthesised UI sound effects, Finds — a curated wall of 158 interface interaction clips credited to their makers — and Bench, an infinite canvas for arranging kept blocks.
contains: interactive React UI blocks you can explore, tweak and take into your projects
82 UI interaction sounds — clicks, pops, drags and swells — synthesised in the browser, playable and downloadable
Finds: a curated wall of 158 interface interactions, each a short clip credited with a link to its maker
Bench: an infinite canvas for arranging kept blocks and returning to the arrangement
